items.subject: First Street (North Platte)
items.note: WGFD identifies First Street as both a launch and take-out. Casper’s October 2024 council packet describes the constructed boat ramp, parking and pathway between First Street and the BNSF bridge, with landscaping and repairs still to finish. Use an approximate facility-area marker; an exact ramp coordinate and current on-site conditions are not asserted.
